description: This file defines internal functions for creating and handling 'Await' objects in PyTorch's JIT, including methods for creating awaitables, waiting for their results, and creating completed awaitables. It also registers these functions as built-in primitives in the Torch JIT system.

methods.name: _awaitable(func, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates an Await object that will call the specified function with given arguments when its result is requested.

methods.name: _awaitable_wait(aw)
methods.description: Waits for the result of the Await object; if not completed, the function is invoked immediately.

methods.name: _awaitable_nowait(o)
methods.description: Creates an already completed Await object with the specified result.
